hook: Your torch lights a cave with its own clouds.
title: Your torch lights a cave with its own clouds
description:
Hang Son Doong in Vietnam is one of the biggest caves on Earth. Sunlight pours through collapsed roofs, so trees grow on the floor and clouds can form inside. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #Vietnam
comment_prompt: Would you go inside? Yes or no
